name: runtime-4-2
command: PYTHONPATH=src:. .nox/tests-3-12-django-4-2/bin/python -c 'import json,pathlib,platform,sys,django,crud_views,crud_views_guardian; root=pathlib.Path("src").resolve(); modules={m.__name__:str(pathlib.Path(m.__file__).resolve()) for m in (crud_views,crud_views_guardian)}; assert all(pathlib.Path(p).is_relative_to(root) for p in modules.values()); print(json.dumps({"python":platform.python_version(),"django":django.get_version(),"executable":sys.executable,"modules":modules}))'
